notes.title: Playtest update
Update and availability
notes.notes:
MacOS and Linux
We've added Linux and MacOS versions of Lostria to Steam! If you have one of these OS, you can now enjoy our game with the playtest version!

Steam functions
We have also started to add Steam features like the leaderboard and microtransactions (sandbox version for the moment) don't hesitate to come and test it all :)

Coming Soon: Using Steam Stats, Achievements and More!
